title: Eduard Zahariev
text: Eduard Zahariev (Bulgarian: Едуард Захариев ; 1 July 1938 – 26 June 1996) was a Bulgarian film director and screenwriter.

title: Manly Times
text: Manly Times (Bulgarian: "Мъжки времена" / "Mazhki vremena") is a Bulgarian drama film released in 1977, directed by Eduard Zahariev, starring Grigor Vachkov, Mariana Dimitrova, Velko Kanev and Pavel Popandov. The screenplay, written by Nikolay Haytov is based on the short stories "Manly Times" and "Wedding" from his book "Wild Stories" (1967).

title: The Hare Census
text: The Hare Census (Bulgarian: "Преброяване на дивите зайци" / "Prebroyavane na Divite Zaytsi") is a Bulgarian satiric comedy film released in 1973, directed by Eduard Zahariev, starring Itzhak Fintzi, Nikola Todev, Georgi Rusev, Evstati Stratev, Philip Trifonov and Todor Kolev.

title: My Darling, My Darling (film)
text: My Darling, My Darling (Bulgarian: Скъпа моя, скъпи мой , translit. Skapa moya, skapi moy) is a 1986 Bulgarian drama film directed by Eduard Zahariev. It was entered into the 36th Berlin International Film Festival.

title: Villa Zone
text: Villa Zone (Bulgarian: "Вилна зона" / "Vilna zona") is a Bulgarian comedy-drama film released in 1975, directed by Eduard Zahariev, starring Itzhak Fintzi, Katya Paskaleva, Naum Shopov, Anton Karastoyanov, Evstati Stratev, Valcho Kamarashev and Georgi Rusev.

title: Eureka, Nunavut
text: Eureka is a small research base on Fosheim Peninsula, Ellesmere Island, Qikiqtaaluk Region, in the Canadian territory of Nunavut. It is located on the north side of Slidre Fiord, which enters Eureka Sound farther west. It is the third-northernmost permanent research community in the world. The only two farther north are Alert, which is also on Ellesmere Island, and Nord, in Greenland. Eureka has the lowest average annual temperature and the lowest amount of precipitation of any weather station in Canada.

title: The Arsonists of Europe
text: The Arsonists of Europe (German: Die Brandstifter Europas) is a 1926 Austrian silent drama film directed by Max Neufeld and starring Charlotte Ander, Eugen Neufeld and Robert Valberg.

title: Mariana Dimitrova
text: Mariana Dimitrova (Bulgarian: Мариана Димитрова ) was a famous Bulgarian actress born on May 28, 1954 in the small village of Kozarevetz, Veliko Turnovo region. She graduated from the Bulgarian film academy. Her second husband was the prominent Bulgarian director Eduard Zahariev. From 1997 to 2005 she lived in San Diego, California.

title: Max Neufeld
text: Max Neufeld (13 February 1887 – 2 December 1967) was an Austrian film director, actor and screenwriter. He directed 70 films between 1919 and 1957. He directed the 1934 film "The Song of the Sun", which starred Vittorio De Sica.

title: A Waltz by Strauss (1925 film)
text: A Waltz by Strauss (German:Ein Walzer von Strauß) is a 1925 Austrian silent film directed by Max Neufeld and starring Eugen Neufeld, Tessy Harrison and Svet Petrovich.
